stage: Additional level-4 reference setup before bounded point-location batches
classification: Resource failure, not a numerical rejection of the atlas method
cause_and_fix: The common-probe element finder could expand a search to all point-element pairs on anisotropic triangles. Limiting inverse-map searches to batches of 128 bounded the temporary allocation. The same finest resolution then ran successfully.
other_jobs: Independent CPU studies were also running; the resource failure is not a measured per-model peak-memory result.
